verdict.rationale: Jules docs explicitly state users are notified when a task completes or needs input, and plan-approval/PR-approval workflows reinforce a human-in-the-loop notification model; community reports also describe reviewing completed PRs after task completion, corroborating the flow works in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of the actual notification channel/mechanism (push, email, in-app) and any critique specific to notification reliability or latency.
